name: Universal Rechargeable Stylus Pen for Touchscreen Devices | Magnetic Stylus with High-Precision Tip | USB Type-C Charging | Compatible with iPad, Android & Tablets
description:
Experience smooth writing, drawing, and note-taking with the Universal Rechargeable Stylus Pen. Designed for iPads, Android tablets, and smartphones, this lightweight digital pen features a high-precision tip for accurate performance. Its rechargeable battery and USB Type-C charging make it ideal for students, artists, and professionals.

Key Features
High-precision tip for smooth writing and drawing
Compatible with iPad, Android tablets, and smartphones
Magnetic design for convenient storage
USB Type-C rechargeable battery
Long battery life and standby time
Smooth and lag-free writing experience
Perfect for note-taking, sketching, and signatures
Lightweight and ergonomic design
No app or Bluetooth pairing required
Easy to carry and use anywhere

Product Specifications
Product Type: Rechargeable Stylus Pen
Charging Port: USB Type-C
Battery Type: Rechargeable Lithium Battery
Charging Time: Approximately 30 minutes
Battery Backup: 8–10 hours
Material: Metal and ABS
Color: White
Origin: Made in China

Compatible Devices
iPad Air (4th Generation)
iPad Pro 11-inch (1st, 2nd, and 3rd Generation)
iPad Pro 12.9-inch (3rd, 4th, and 5th Generation)
Android smartphones and tablets
Windows touchscreen devices
Other capacitive touchscreen devices

How to Use
Charge the stylus using the USB Type-C cable
Turn on the stylus pen
Start writing or drawing directly on your device
Recharge when the battery is low
Store safely after use

Material / Composition
Metal body
ABS plastic
Rechargeable lithium battery
Precision stylus tip

Safety Information
Keep away from water and heat
Do not disassemble the device
Charge only with compatible chargers
Keep out of reach of children
Store in a cool, dry place

Package Includes
1 × Universal Rechargeable Stylus Pen
1 × USB Type-C Charging Cable
1 × User Manual
